description: JavaScript source code defining the GOTEO namespace, including functions for rendering funding and co-funder charts with interactive hover effects, utilizing D3.js for SVG manipulation and chart rendering.

methods.name: GOTEO.visualizers.renderFunds
methods.description: Renders a chart visualizing funds gathered over time with interactive hover info.

methods.name: GOTEO.visualizers.renderCofunders
methods.description: Renders a chart showing number of donations over time with interactive hover info.

methods.name: GOTEO.utilities.leftTip
methods.description: Generates SVG path data for tooltip arrow pointing left or right.

methods.name: GOTEO.utilities.onHover
methods.description: Handles mouse hover event to display interactive info boxes on funding and co-funder charts.

methods.name: GOTEO.utilities.offHover
methods.description: Handles mouse out event to hide info boxes and reset chart elements.
